identities.pictureStreamIds: readonly number[], positive ascending demux IDs

descriptor.tags: optional readonly Record<string,string>; actual stream metadata only
descriptor.dispositions: optional readonly string[]; attached_pic intrinsic to pictureStreamIds
descriptor.usable: optional boolean; proven codec parameters after probing

selectors: existing all/absolute/a/v and relative numeric selectors
0:V and 0:V:N (no matches in FLAC attached-picture-only video model)
metadataRules: ASCII case-insensitive key, case-sensitive exact value, first matching dictionary key; absent descriptor is unknown and throws unsupported-command; present descriptor without tags means known empty stream metadata. Native parses metadata before opt_map examines its remainder: a trailing ? is a literal metadata key/value character, NOT optional-map syntax. Colon/quote/backslash escaping is explicitly unsupported.
lifetime: Snapshot command synchronously before first provider await. Descriptors are immutable borrowed scalar data consumed synchronously by selectFlacStreams, never retained; output and policy are frozen. No reader, payload, await, cancellation listener or output side effect in helper.
memory: 64 maps / streams / selected duplicates / descriptors; 128 map characters; aggregate 1024 own tags and 65536 UTF-16 tag characters; 64 flags per descriptor with max64 chars. No media buffers allocated: caller owns actual Core metadata/codec reservations and release, bounded abort-aware reads, late rejection observation, demux cleanup and transactional publication.
integration: flac-copy.ts, flac-decode.ts and flac-wave-remux.ts snapshot selection before provider awaits and call selectFlacStreams with the Root-owned flacStreamIdentities(demux) helper.

flac-stream-identities.ts constructs frozen streamDescriptors: audio {streamId:0,tags:Object.freeze({}),dispositions:Object.freeze([])} with usable:true when STREAMINFO proves sample rate/channels/bits per sample. FLAC Vorbis metadata.tags are container tags, NOT audio stream tags; they are not copied onto stream0.

Each demux.attachedPictures[index] maps to streamId:index+1, tags:picture.descriptor.tags after accepted-kind narrowing, dispositions:Object.freeze(['attached_pic']). The descriptor list is frozen and retains no picture chunks or payload.

Picture usable remains unknown: it requires nonzero dimensions and a known decoded pixel format after probing, not declared dimensions alone. Usable selectors requiring unknown picture facts reject explicitly.

Continue rejecting selected picture output unless the output mux path explicitly supports it. Never filter pictureStreamIds to make an audio backend succeed. Keep Core reservations, abort-aware waits, close/finally and atomic output group publication in caller.
